svg.text: Who holds which score: a 64 × 64 tile of S = Q Kᵀ, 4 warps, 16 × 8 MMA tiles
Warp 0 owns rows 0–15. Its strip is 8 MMA tiles of 16 rows × 8 keys.
Blue: rows 0 and 8, which lanes 0–3 (one quad) hold.
One 16 × 8 MMA tile, zoomed: the lane that holds each value

svg.text: in 2 rows (r and r + 8) of every tile.
The 4 lanes of a quad share those rows:
lanes 0–3 hold all of rows 0 and 8.
So the maximum (or sum) of a row is
1. a max over the lane's own 16 values,
with lane xor 2, then with lane xor 1.
